lean.statement: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (f : X → ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable f mu → ∀ {M : ℝ}, (∀ᵐ x ∂mu, |f x| ≤ M) → (∫ x, f x ∂mu) = 0 → ∀ᶠ e : ℝ in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), (∀ᵐ x ∂mu, (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ 1 + e * f x) ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure (mu.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (1 + e * f x))) ∧ InformationTheory.klDiv (mu.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (1 + e * f x))) mu = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, InformationTheory.klFun (1 + e * f x) ∂mu)
approved_definition_context: AEStronglyMeasurable f mu means equality almost everywhere with a strongly measurable function. The displayed bound is almost everywhere, not a pointwise representative condition.
The notation ∀ᶠ e in 𝓝 0 means all sufficiently small real e, including zero; ∀ᵐ x ∂mu means mu-almost every x.
mu.withDensity h is the measure obtained by integrating the nonnegative extended-real density h. ENNReal.ofReal r is max(r,0) embedded into the nonnegative extended reals and is never infinity.
InformationTheory.klFun u is u*Real.log u+1-u. The real logarithm and real Bochner integral are totalized APIs; an undefined real integral has value zero.

InformationTheory.klDiv nu mu is the canonical nonnegative extended-real divergence: infinity unless nu is absolutely continuous relative to mu and its log likelihood ratio is nu-integrable, otherwise ofReal of the log likelihood integral plus mu's total mass minus nu's total mass.
